notes:
A compound covering three types of government authorization: {許可|きょか} (permission), {認可|にんか} (approval), and implicitly {免許|めんきょ} (license). Frequently discussed in the context of bureaucratic regulation and deregulation in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {許認可|きょにんか}{権|けん}: authority to grant permits
- {許認可|きょにんか}{手続|てつづ}き: permit/licensing procedures
- {許認可|きょにんか}{制度|せいど}: permit and licensing system
- {許認可|きょにんか}{行政|ぎょうせい}: regulatory administration
- {許認可|きょにんか}を{得|え}る: to obtain authorization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {許可|きょか}: permission, approval — a single act of granting permission
- {認可|にんか}: authorization, accreditation — official recognition or approval
- {免許|めんきょ}: license — a specific qualification to perform an activity

definitions.explanation: the various types of official government permissions, approvals, and licenses required to conduct certain activities or businesses

examples.japanese: {許認可|きょにんか}を{取得|しゅとく}する。
{飲食店|いんしょくてん}を{開|ひら}くには{様々|さまざま}な{許認可|きょにんか}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Various permits and licenses are needed to open a restaurant.

examples.japanese: {規制|きせい}{緩和|かんわ}によって{許認可|きょにんか}{手続|てつづ}きが{簡素化|かんそか}された。
examples.english: Deregulation has simplified the permit and licensing procedures.
